pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of John the Baptist to the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing John the Baptist to the Messiah.
   C. Say John the Baptist to the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use John the Baptist to the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Accounts of Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Accounts of Creation.
   B. Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Accounts of Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Accounts of Creation has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Translation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Translation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Bible Translation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Translation.
   D. Say Bible Translation has no place in daily life.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

7. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.
   B. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Use of Natural Resources? (1 mark)
   A. Use Use of Natural Resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Use of Natural Resources.
   D. Say Use of Natural Resources has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Functions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Functions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Functions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Functions of the Bible.
   D. Apply the teaching of Functions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership in Israel has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel.
   C. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Leadership in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Bible Translation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership in Israel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Prophecies about the Messiah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain John the Baptist to the Messiah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. A — Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Bible Translation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

7. C — Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. B — Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Apply the teaching of Functions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Bible Translation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Leadership in Israel; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prophecies about the Messiah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of John the Baptist to the Messiah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
